purpose: Hash-pinned access record for the Taisho witnesses that this pack's rules cite. Every rule citation resolves to a line key in one of the *_lines.txt renderings recorded here.
not_onmyodo: Sukuyodo is the Buddhist astral tradition transmitted through Chinese Buddhist translation from Indian and Iranian material. It is not Onmyodo. The repository's separate `onmyodo/` track covers the yin-yang and five-phase court tradition of the Onmyoryo. No source, rule, or vector may cross between the two tracks.

retrieval.method: HTTPS GET of CBETA's TEI P5 corpus as published on GitHub

rights_note.cbeta_header_statement: Available for non-commercial use when distributed with this header intact.
rights_note.observed_where: TEI header, fileDesc/publicationStmt/availability, present verbatim in each stored XML file
rights_note.assessment: NOT assumed public domain. The transcription carries CBETA's stated non-commercial condition, and the Taisho edition itself carries its own publisher terms. The stored XML retains the CBETA header unmodified so the condition travels with the file. Research use inside this repository is within the stated condition; any customer-facing reproduction of these transcriptions requires a separate rights review.
rights_note.consequence: Quotation in research documents is permitted and is done with full passage addresses. Redistribution of the transcription as product content is not authorized by this manifest.

artifacts.work: 文殊師利菩薩及諸仙所說吉凶時日善惡宿曜經
artifacts.attributed_translator: 不空 Amoghavajra (Bukong), rendered 759 CE (乾元二年)
artifacts.attributed_annotator: 楊景風 Yang Jingfeng, revised annotation 764 CE (廣德二年)

artifacts.description: Line-addressed plain text. Key format T21n1299_p0391b06 = Taisho vol. 21, text 1299, page 391, column b, line 06. Apparatus variants are dropped in favour of the lemma reading; notes, mulu and anchors are dropped.
artifacts.role: citation surface for every rule in sukuyo_rule_manifest.json

artifacts.attributed_compiler: 西天竺國婆羅門僧金俱吒 (a brahmin monk of West India, name transcribed 金俱吒)
artifacts.role: contrast witness: planetary apotropaic procedure, mansion-degree apportionment, planetary ephemeris tables, and a twelve-place scheme

artifacts.attributed_author: 唐 一行述 (attributed to Yixing; attribution is a transmission claim, not established authorship)
artifacts.role: second contrast witness: opens with 二十八宿 and runs a nine-luminary (九曜) age cycle, i.e. a different scheme from T1299's 27-mansion cycle. Acquired to prove the schemes are separable, not to be merged into them.

attempted_and_failed.target: SAT Daizokyo Text Database (University of Tokyo)
attempted_and_failed.result: HTTP 200 with a 57-byte body containing an unsubstituted SQL fragment (`select minn,maxn from minmax where num =  and num2 = ''`). The parameter names guessed for this endpoint are wrong and the service leaked its query template instead of erroring.
attempted_and_failed.consequence: No SAT text was retrieved and none is cited. SAT is not required: CBETA serves the same Taisho text with the same page/column/line addresses, and both were retrieved successfully.
attempted_and_failed.would_unblock: The current SAT API parameter documentation, or the SAT2018 permalink form (satdb2018pre.php with a `useid` of the form 1299_,21,0387a01), which would allow an independent second transcription for collation against CBETA.

attempted_and_failed.target: Japanese Sukuyodo practitioner manuals (e.g. 宿曜占文抄, 宿曜運命勘録)
attempted_and_failed.result: Not retrievable as full text. NDL Search returns catalogue and article records only.
attempted_and_failed.consequence: This pack contains NO Japanese-side Sukuyodo rule. Everything encoded is from the Chinese Taisho text that the Japanese tradition read. The Japanese reception layer is declared source_gated, not silently assumed identical.
attempted_and_failed.would_unblock: A digitized or edited text of 『宿曜占文抄』 (Kozan-ji holding, discussed in Udai Takafumi, 'Enkeishiki Hokuto mandara ko', NDL record R000000004-I023457152) or of a dated Sukuyodo divination record (kanmon) from the Insei/Kamakura period corpus surveyed in Akazawa Haruhiko, 『院政期・鎌倉期の宿曜道と宿曜師』 (2021, NDL record R100000136-I1010009142284836736).
